steps.instruction: Heat 1 cup of butter or margarine very gently in a saucepan.
Add 1 cup of all-purpose flour to the pan.
Cook over low to medium heat until golden brown.
steps.spoken: Cook for 40 minutes over low to moderate heat, until golden brown.

steps.instruction: Combine 1 1/4 cups of sugar and 5 cups of water in a separate saucepan.
steps.spoken: When the flour turns light golden, combine 1 1/4 cups of sugar and 5 cups of water in a separate saucepan.

steps.instruction: Boil the sugar and water gently to make a syrup.
Pour the syrup into the saucepan with the flour.
Scoop small portions of halva with a wooden spoon.
Place the balls on a serving plate.
steps.spoken: Place the balls on a serving plate. Serve warm.
